_comment: Audit Readiness v1 policy. Everything the runner is allowed to decide lives here, not in code.

budget._comment: Cost gate. A tool that exceeds its share is marked PARTIAL, never silently allowed to run all night.
budget._commentLargeRepoBasis: The large-repo threshold is measured on ANALYZABLE SOURCE FILES, never on production files. Evidence: next.js has 3301 production but 25154 source files and CodeQL still died on the default heap until --ram=8192.

coverage._comment: A target with no parseable source is not clean. These are the counters that make that visible.

disclosure._comment: Gate D. No channel means no report is possible no matter how good the analysis is. A monitored security inbox IS a vetted channel, and it is not spelled 'security@': nestjs ships support@nestjs.com. Over-narrow signal lists silently downgrade real disclosure channels to 'no vetting', which is how a previous campaign wrongly reported 0 of 12 targets as having SECURITY.md.

correlation._comment: Deterministic join only. No model, no guessing.

publication._comment: Human keeps control. The runner prepares; it never sends.
